title: Insight into the autoproteolysis mechanism of the RsgI9 anti-sigma factor from Clostridium thermocellum.
authors: Takayesu, Allen; Mahoney, Brendan J; Goring, Andrew K; Jessup, Tobie; Ogorzalek Loo, Rachel R; Loo, Joseph A; Clubb, Robert T
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RsgI9抗sigma因子CRE结构域的自蛋白酶解机制，涉及蛋白质-DNA互作体系（RsgI9调控纤维素体基因表达），但核心是蛋白质自裂解而非TF-DNA结合，方法上使用AlphaFold2和MD模拟，对TF-DNA互作建模有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: Clostridium thermocellum is a potential microbial platform to convert abundant plant biomass to biofuels and other renewable chemicals. It efficiently degrades lignocellulosic biomass using a surface displayed cellulosome, a megadalton sized multienzyme containing complex. The enzymatic composition and architecture of the cellulosome is controlled by several transmembrane biomass-sensing RsgI-type anti-sigma factors. Recent studies suggest that these factors transduce signals from the cell surface via a conserved RsgI extracellular (CRE) domain (also called a periplasmic domain) that undergoes autoproteolysis through an incompletely understood mechanism. Here we report the structure of the autoproteolyzed CRE domain from the C. thermocellum RsgI9 anti-sigma factor, revealing that the cleaved fragments forming this domain associate to form a stable alpha/beta/alpha sandwich fold. Based on AlphaFold2 modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, and tandem mass spectrometry, we propose that a conserved Asn-Pro bond in RsgI9 autoproteolyzes via a succinimide intermediate whose formation is promoted by a conserved hydrogen bond network holding the scissile peptide bond in a strained conformation. As other RsgI anti-sigma factors share sequence homology to RsgI9, they likely autoproteolyze through a similar mechanism.
abstract_zh: Clostridium thermocellum是一种潜在的微生物平台，可将丰富的植物生物质转化为生物燃料和其他可再生化学品。它利用表面展示的纤维素体（cellulosome）高效降解木质纤维素生物质，这是一种兆道尔顿大小的多酶复合体。纤维素体的酶组成和结构由几种跨膜生物质感应型RsgI抗sigma因子控制。近期研究表明，这些因子通过一个保守的RsgI胞外（CRE）结构域（也称为周质结构域）从细胞表面转导信号，该结构域通过一种尚未完全理解的机制进行自蛋白水解。在此，我们报道了来自C. thermocellum RsgI9抗sigma因子的自蛋白水解CRE结构域的结构，揭示形成该结构域的切割片段组装成一个稳定的alpha/beta/alpha三明治折叠。基于AlphaFold2建模、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和串联质谱分析，我们提出RsgI9中一个保守的Asn-Pro键通过琥珀酰亚胺中间体进行自蛋白水解，该中间体的形成由一个保守的氢键网络促进，该网络将可切割肽键维持在一个应变构象中。由于其他RsgI抗sigma因子与RsgI9具有序列同源性，它们可能通过类似机制进行自蛋白水解。
